text.en:
The Minister of Finance, upon recommendation of the Commissioner of Internal Revenue, shall
promulgate necessary rules and regulations to effectively implement the provisions of this order.
All laws, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of April, in the Year of Our Lord Nineteen Hundred and
Eighty-Five.
